name: 06_bad_value_kind_rejected
description: A seed declaring kind=bytes but carrying a numeric (f64) value is a kind/payload mismatch — a malformed CELL, not an unknown TIER. instantiate must reject it with `bad-value-kind` (NOT `unknown-level`), identically on both cores. The floor/level are valid, so the rejection is the decode, isolating the new variant.
